CommunityApplications.Profile:
Valheim dedicated server for Unraid with built-in Thunderstore mod support.
- Install mods by name, by thunderstore.io link, or by pasting an r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager profile code. BepInEx and all dependencies are installed automatically. - Valheim and your mods are kept up to date automatically, and the server only restarts once nobody is online. - Choose the world seed, difficulty preset and world modifiers. - The world is saved cleanly on stop and backed up before every restart.
No game files are included: Valheim is downloaded from Steam on first start. Not affiliated with Iron Gate or Thunderstore.
For help, bug reports and feature requests, use the support thread linked on this page or open an issue on GitHub.
